title: Compare survival-only with the original reward
doing: Propose original score-plus-alive-minus-death versus alive-minus-death at a locked recipe, two training seeds per arm. Keep engine score and pattern gates unchanged, report raw score, encounter exposure and survival, and distinguish slower score-gated difficulty exposure from better avoidance. No launch authorized.
expected: Removing score reward may reduce risky choices, but the high-scoring heuristic shows scoring is not inherently fatal. Apparent survival improvement could come from reaching harder score-gated patterns later rather than better control.

evidence.label: User priority-order steer, reviewed with current local evidence
